notes: Added required stories for Board Certification Verification feature.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for board certification signal
Added core logic for certification extraction and verification

EVAL-P-MEASURE-1-S1.title: Define Board Certification Schema and Contract
EVAL-P-MEASURE-1-S1.description: Define a structured schema for board certification signals including certification status, board name, specialty alignment, and verification source from NPI registry.

EVAL-P-MEASURE-1-S2.title: Implement Board Certification Extraction and Verification Logic
EVAL-P-MEASURE-1-S2.description: Parse NPI registry response to extract board certification indicators, normalize certification data, and determine verification status.

EVAL-P-MEASURE-1-S3.title: Integrate Certification Logic into Provider Detail Service
EVAL-P-MEASURE-1-S3.description: Embed board certification verification logic into provider_detail_service so certification signals are included in provider detail responses.

EVAL-P-MEASURE-1-S4.title: Expose Board Certification via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-P-MEASURE-1-S4.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to include board certification signals in provider detail responses for downstream consumption.

EVAL-P-MEASURE-1-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Board Certification Verification
EVAL-P-MEASURE-1-S5.description: Create unit tests for extraction and normalization logic and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from NPI lookup to facade response.

EVAL-P-MEASURE-1.mitigation: Fallback to 'unknown certification status' when NPI data is incomplete.
Clearly label certification source as NPI registry and avoid overclaiming verification.
